verdict.rationale: The job-creation API has its own documented privacy option: when enabled, it immediately redacts the original input_url and deletes transcript segments after 12 hours. That is real per-job retention control, but it is a single fixed setting rather than configurable retention or on-demand deletion. Missing for 10: a configurable retention window, an explicit delete endpoint for jobs, transcripts or uploaded files, a documented default retention policy for uploaded audio, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
